$comment: Message -> derived argument and markup metadata (RFC 0002 §5 'derived metadata'). Each test: `description`; the message as either `src` (MF2 syntax) or `mf1` plus `locale` (ICU MessageFormat 1, converted first); `arguments`: the message's external variables in order of first appearance (declarations, then selectors, then patterns), each {name, type, function?, selector?}. `type` is one of string|number|integer|percent|currency|date|time|datetime|unit|select, inferred from the variable's annotation: its .input declaration wins, otherwise the first annotated use (locals propagate to the variable they are bound to); unannotated variables are string, and a :string selector is select. `function` is the annotating function's name when there is one. `selector` is present when the variable (directly or through a .local) is a selector: {kind: plural|ordinal|exact|string, keys: the literal variant keys in order of appearance; the catch-all * always exists and is not listed}. `markup`: distinct {name, kind} markup elements in order of first appearance, kind being open|standalone|close.
